body: This can use a comment explaining what the code does (e.g. something like "The following code is performing a tree walk, to avoid recursive calls and `todo` allocations.")
This check is now broken, it will loop forever.
I'm not sure if this section works. When the last sibling is done, how would it return to the parent?

@Ivorforce The check `current_node->data.index + 1 < (int)siblings.size()` would return `false` because the node is at the end of its siblings. That triggers the `// Go back to parent` code to run which will eventually go back to `this`, at which point it will break out of both `while` loops due to the condition.
That check is in the `p_recursive` branch, not in this one.
